method: imagegen: original artwork cleanup, external and internal ink removed
common_prompt: Precise cleanup edit of the supplied original game icon, not redesign. Remove ALL dark navy/black drawn outline strokes, BOTH outer silhouette outlines and all internal contour lines. Reconstruct the adjacent coloured surface across the removed ink; separate shapes by their original colours and soft natural shading, never by dark strokes. Preserve exact geometry, silhouette, object positions, proportions, optical centre, painted texture, saturated palette, highlights and all meaningful subject details. Do not melt, merge, simplify, warp or add shapes. Keep the same square canvas and artwork placement. Real transparent RGBA background, no outside shadow, no glow, no frame. Runtime shader will supply the exterior outline; output artwork must be free of ink contours.

files.prompt: Precise, minimal edit of this exact existing transparent gold coin-stack game asset. Change ONLY the embossed letter on the TOP FACE OF THE UPPERMOST COIN. The current raised symbol is malformed. Replace it with a clean capital Latin H, shaped like the clear H on the front leaning coin, but correctly foreshortened to lie flat on the top coin's elliptical face: two parallel straight stems joined by one centred crossbar, crisp and symmetric, all four ends intact. Keep it raised gold with matching orange relief shading and original lighting; no navy/black outline. Keep the top coin rim ellipse and all other pixels/objects as unchanged as possible: same coin stack count, silhouettes, positions, leaning front coin and its existing H, bottom partial H, gold shading, highlights, composition and optical centre. Do not redraw or reshape the stack, do not add symbols, outlines, shadows, glows or background. Genuine transparent RGBA background and same square framing.
files.normalization: Uniform premultiplied-alpha resize to original visual bounds; original canvas and optical centre retained. No pixel recolouring or morphology.
